_notes: Transparent soft-factor adjustment layer (injuries, key-player availability,
lineup/tactical changes, motivation). These factors are NOT available from any
free, verifiable, auto-updating feed, so they are explicit, dated, human-curated
Each entry multiplies a team's expected goals: attack_mult scales the goals the
team is expected to SCORE; defense_mult scales the goals it is expected to CONCEDE
(>1 = leakier defense). 1.0 = no change. Keep deltas modest (typically 0.85-1.15)
and ALWAYS include a dated, sourced 'note' so every assumption is auditable.
